scripts.precommit: bun run check && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run publish-packages && changeset tag
scripts.publish-packages: bun run publish-package:schema && bun run publish-package:studio
scripts.publish-package:schema: cd packages/schema && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && npm publish "$tgz" && rm -f "$tgz"
scripts.publish-package:studio: cd packages/studio && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && npm publish "$tgz" --access restricted && rm -f "$tgz"
scripts.verify-pack: bun run verify-pack:schema && bun run verify-pack:studio
scripts.verify-pack:schema: bun run build --filter=@openenvx/schema && cd packages/schema && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && echo "==> packages/schema ($tgz)" && tar -tzf "$tgz" | head -20 && tar -xOf "$tgz" package/package.json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const exp=d.exports?.['.']; const def=typeof exp==='string'?exp:exp?.default; if(!def?.includes('dist/')){console.error('Published export must point at dist, got:',exp);process.exit(1)} if(!d.files?.includes('dist')){console.error('files must include dist');process.exit(1)} console.log('schema pack ok, default export:',def)" && rm -f *.tgz
scripts.verify-pack:studio: bun run build --filter=@xmazu/openenvxee-studio && cd packages/studio && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && echo "==> packages/studio ($tgz)" && tar -xOf "$tgz" package/package.json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const deps=d.dependencies??{}; const bad=Object.entries(deps).filter(([k,v])=>k.startsWith('@openenvx/')||k.startsWith('@xmazu/openenvxee-')||String(v).startsWith('workspace:')||String(v).startsWith('catalog:')); if(bad.length){console.error('Bad runtime deps:',Object.fromEntries(bad)); process.exit(1)} else {console.log('studio runtime deps ok:', deps)}" && rm -f *.tgz
